page.title: Devices
page.description: Inventory is the authorization source for Health Watch, SNMP, and device inspection. Discovery is optional.

add.title: Add device manually
add.description: Saving one IP as an inventory node does not run Discovery, ping, or SNMP.
add.name: Name

import.title: Import from Discovery
import.description: Discovery remains manual and on demand. A discovered device can be saved through the existing Save Identity flow.

list.title: Devices
list.description: One inventory for device identity and Health Watch configuration.
list.empty: There are no devices in inventory yet.
list.deleteConfirm: Delete inventory device {{device}}? Remove Health Watch and SNMP configuration first. No unrelated history will be erased automatically.

health.title: Network Health Watch
health.description: Scheduled ICMP runs only through the selected runner. Removing this configuration does not delete the inventory device, SNMP configuration, telemetry, or diagnostic history.
health.removeConfirm: Remove Health Watch configuration for {{device}}? The inventory device and SNMP configuration will remain.
health.runnerUnavailable: A diagnostic runner is not available yet.

profile.title: Device Profile
profile.operatorRequired: Operator role is required to run active inspection.
profile.healthAddFailed: The target could not be added to Network Health Watch.
profile.deadlinePartial: The internal safety deadline stopped optional probes.
profile.collectorPartial: One or more optional enrichment probes did not complete.
profile.partialEvidence: Evidence already collected remains valid; missing fields were not inferred.
profile.insufficientBody: The target responded, but bounded probes did not expose enough metadata to name a manufacturer, model, or exact device type. This is a successful partial result, not an inspection failure.
profile.servicesEmpty: No identifying service metadata was observed in the bounded allow-list.
profile.tcpNotice: Timeout is reported as timeout, not guessed to be firewall-filtered. Ports outside the allow-list were not tested.
profile.softwareEmpty: No software identity was exposed by the selected HTTP endpoints.
profile.evidenceEmpty: The host may still be useful as manual inventory even when no identity metadata is returned.
profile.missingIdentity: Not exposed by this inspection: {{fields}}. Absence is not evidence that those attributes do not exist.
profile.conflictTitle: The saved operator category may not match the detected network role.
profile.conflictBody: Inspection identified this address as This Device. The saved category remains unchanged; review and edit it explicitly if needed.
profile.safetyNotice: Quick Inspect uses a fixed, bounded service allow-list. It is not a vulnerability scan. Routed targets do not expose their target MAC through local ARP; unmanaged Layer-2 switches may have no discoverable IP; MTR shows responding Layer-3 hops only.
